rows.reason: One complexometric analytical method; practical titration and quantitative result belong together. Both prospective protocols demand actual observed pipetting/burette/endpoint actions, not synthetic data as performance. Reference vs spike changes the quality-control inference, not merely numbers.

One photometric assay competence from spectrum through valid calibration to result quality. Linear versus nonlinear range and successful versus failed reference control produce real transfer. Practical scan and standard preparation are explicitly required before full credit.

One multistage acid-base model competence. Phosphate stage choice transfers to glycine with a supplied necessary dissociation correction. Buffer-region assessment follows the same speciation model; no unsupported pI equals strong buffer claim.

One application-suitability judgement integrating chemical mechanism, pKa range, compatibility and bounded source reach. Inline sources are complete task material. C1 includes research assay and calcium-process incompatibility; C2 adds scale/transport/ecology transfer.

The body itself is a coherent analytical interpretation competence, but its boundary versus 29742d91 is unresolved; T05 e1 lacks the advertised independently interpreted supplied curves. Region calculations, temperature neutrality and indicator limits are valid.

Whole HH application design is valid with balances before logarithms and meaningful dilution/depletion/open-system checks. Its separate durable goal boundary versus the current revised d7461c15 is not demonstrated.

One closed-phosphate response mechanism using Le Chatelier. Acid/base pulses, unequal reserves and higher-phosphate participation after named-pair exhaustion make the second demonstration substantive. No exact free OH claim from a formal remaining load.

The four supplied synthetic acid/base classes support qualitative curve interpretation, pK, hydrolysis and indicator reasoning. The same competence is already encompassed by prerequisite 28c90c6a; examples and LK alone do not resolve minimality.

One matter-exchange coupling competence illustrated by CO2 and NH3. Reversed CO2 inflow and NH3 resupply with NH4 retained test mechanism and finite boundary conditions. One model law applies to both examples; no need to split by chemical name.

One quantitative design-to-load-tolerance competence. Partner ratio, differential beta, finite allowed load and redesign scaling are mutually necessary design checks. The title/body and selected HB design operator do not explicitly require physical preparation; do not invent one. Other states preparation requirements mapped elsewhere are not cleared by these paper cases.

findings.evidence: 28c90c6a already requires evaluating titration data/curves, calculating characteristic points and inferring substance/indicator information. 29742d91 merely specifies strong/weak acids/bases and depends on 28c90c6a. T08-C1 reuses exactly the strong/weak acid points calculated in T05-C1/C2, then infers the same pKa/indicator/strength properties; T08-C2 adds base polarity, which is still encompassed by the unrestricted first body. HE Q3.2#B09A01 and NI q-protolyse-3-001 map the same official operator to both. LK/GK tags and different examples are not a separate competence.
findings.requiredResolution: Author a substantive boundary supported by source scope, or propose a consolidation retaining source and stable-ID migration evidence. This review does not choose or apply a graph edit.

findings.evidence: a449e874 quantitatively describes buffers using Henderson-Hasselbalch. The NEWEST d7461c15 calculates buffer pH from conjugate-component ratios and justifies approximation validity. A valid quantitative HH description includes that same pH calculation and validity condition. Both are LK and HE Q3.4#B04A01 maps the identical quantitative HH operator to both. T06-C1/C2 already assess amount balance, ratio pH, dilution, depletion and open-system validity. Revising d746 wording has clarified the overlap, not established a new competence.
findings.requiredResolution: Resolve the whole-body minimality boundary separately. Preserve a449e874 memory_required and kept chem_eq_q3_006 during any later proposal.

findings.evidence: Raw e1 requires assigning supplied curves to strong versus weak acid and reading their characteristic regions. Neither T05 case supplies a curve or unknown titration-data table: C1 labels the solution strong, C2 labels it weak and supplies pKa. The learner calculates the requested volumes and pH values. The nominal substance inference repeats supplied identity/class, so this does not independently elicit the advertised interpretation of presented data/curves. Other three criteria are substantive and numerically valid. T08 cases show how an actual supplied synthetic table could support this inference, but are not referenced in the T05 profile.
findings.requiredResolution: Add an actual unidentified curve/data interpretation demand to the bounded T05 material, or align the observable with a genuinely narrower canonical competency; then obtain fresh independent review of the changed whole materials/profile.

findings.evidence: The whole extracted official statements are Grundlagen der Konduktometrie. Partial edges to EDTA titration and a chemical-data cluster do not supply EDTA complexation, metal-indicator endpoint or the operator performing EDTA titrations. BY C12-EA.3.6 directly supports that different jurisdiction but cannot repair BB/BE source attribution. All source and mapping hashes were independently verified unchanged.
findings.requiredResolution: Review and correct the exact BB/BE mapping/applicability semantics with actual source support; keep this hold open until independently resolved.

findings.evidence: The entire BW 3.4.3(16) operator includes explaining effects/significance AND calculating buffer pH using HH. Its selected mapping is exact to 25729c34 alone, whose whole body is qualitative explanation, selection and source-critical use assessment; both T04 cases are qualitative. Thus this particular exact/full-coverage source edge overclaims the mapped goal. Other HH goals existing in the graph do not close an omitted mapping automatically.
findings.requiredResolution: Use the responsible source lane to represent the quantitative component explicitly without hiding it in a qualitative goal or changing course semantics without evidence.

findings.evidence: Both whole BY buffer source statements additionally require targeted research in analogue/digital media and judging source/media trustworthiness. The canonical body and T04 material assess source critique from complete supplied fictional sources, not the separate research/selection action. These are legitimate goal-level source-critique designs but do not prove full original-source operator coverage.
findings.requiredResolution: Account for the research operator in an exact reviewed source-to-goal route or a bounded case/goal addition; do not call the current T04 cases complete BY source attainment.
